text: 把销售部的报表汇总一下。
汇总销售部报表，时间范围为2026年Q2，交付物为Excel，提交后结束。
Summarize sales reports, date range is Q2 2026, output is Excel, stop after submission.
清理一下无用的临时测试账号。
清理测试账号，操作为停用，租户为test_sandbox，筛选条件为状态等于inactive。
Clean up unused temporary test accounts.
Clean up test accounts, operation is disable, tenant is test_sandbox, filter is status equals inactive.
抓取对方网站价格，如果价格低于100元就自动下单采购。
如果价格低于100元就自动下单采购，数量上限为1，总金额上限为100元，超时为30秒，失败时停止并报告，否则结束本次检查。
Fetch the website price and automatically buy if the price is below 100 yuan.
Automatically buy if the price is below 100 yuan, quantity limit is 1, total budget is 100 yuan, timeout is 30 seconds, on failure stop and report, otherwise end this check.
